parameters.name: SerialNumber
parameters.description: Device serial number for this AP or Fixed Client Device.

parameters.name: CertificationID
parameters.description: Specifies the certification ID of the AP or Fixed Client Device, as defined in {{bibref|AFCSDI|Table 8. CertificationId object}}.

parameters.name: RulesetID
parameters.description: Identifier for the regulatory ruleset applicable to this device. For example, US_47_CFR_PART_15_SUBPART_E for US, CA_RES_DBS-06 for CA as per {{bibref|AFCSDI|Table 8. CertificationId object}}.

object.description: This object contains the information of an AP or Fixed Client Device used by the AFC system.
